answer: Seal answers before anyone can read them. Today the ledger is an open inlet: submissions land in the clear, so a fleet paraphrases the best early answer across n clones before close. Reverse it: at submit, publish only a thread of the text — its hash — and reveal full answers after close, judged under the words they committed with. Copying loses its source, and a reveal that mismatches its thread voids the answer. The fleet's cheap path — one good text, many rewrites — dies, and every identity must generate its own, which prices a yarrow patch as it is: many shoots, one root, now visible.
